variants.label: A
variants.subject: your new SDR hires
variants.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Saw {{company_name}} is hiring SDRs. Congrats on the growth.

New reps usually take three months to ramp. While they do, we can run outbound for you: list, copy and replies, with meetings landing on your team's calendar from week two.

Worth a quick chat about bridging the gap?

Grace

variants.label: B
variants.subject: before the new SDRs start
variants.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Quick thought while you are hiring. What if the pipeline was already warm on your new reps' first day?

We build and run the outbound so they start on booked calls instead of a blank list.

Open to seeing how?

Grace

variants.label: C
variants.subject: {{first_name}}, a question on hiring
variants.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Are you hiring SDRs mostly for more meetings, or to build a team for the long run?

If it is the meetings, we can usually get you there faster and cheaper. Happy to compare notes.

Grace
